svg.text: ROUND 354 · 🏆 802 PYTEST CHECKS HISTORIC MILESTONE · HIGHER ED SIS (ELLUCIAN BANNER / WORKDAY), TITLE IV FAFSA & NIH/NSF GRANTS
Higher Education SIS (Ellucian Banner/Workday), Title IV Aid & Grant Subaward AI Security FAQ
Endowment & Major Donor Dossier Air-Gap + Title IV Ghost-Student Attendance & SAP Lock vs. FAFSA Appeal Injection & NIH Subaward Wire Fraud (BRK-717 / BRK-718)
🚨 1. Top 3 Higher Ed SIS & Research Grant Threat Vectors
① FAFSA Appeal Injection Leaking Endowment & Donors (BRK-717)
• Adversarial ghost-student ring FAFSA Professional Judgment
(PJ) dependency appeal PDF embeds indirect prompt injection
• Coerces Agent into reading Board endowment private-equity
allocations, major donor wealth dossiers & legacy admission scores
② Ghost-Student Title IV Pell & Loan Refund Fraud (BRK-717)
• Overrides Student Aid Index (SAI) to -1500 & lifts Satisfactory
Academic Progress (SAP) & attendance holds in Banner/Workday
• Disburses maximum Title IV Pell & Direct Loan credit-balance refunds
• Impact: Multi-million-dollar Title IV bot fraud & DOE liability
③ Spoofed NIH/NSF Subrecipient Grant Wire Fraud (BRK-718)
• Forged 2 CFR 200 research subrecipient invoice & F&A indirect
cost banking update overwrites subawardee IBAN in trust-registry
• Triggers unauthorized $5,180 subaward wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Federal research grant theft & OIG Single Audit findings
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Higher Ed SIS & Grant Defense-in-Depth
Gate 1: FAFSA PJ Appeal / Subaward Invoice Sanitization
• Strips free-text hardship narratives; extracts typed ISIR/grant
slots (FAFSA UUID, IRS FTI hash, enrolled credits, NIH award ID)
• Propagates untrusted=True, lane="attack" across all agent hops
Gate 2: Endowment & Advancement Donor Dossier Air-Gap
• Board endowment holdings, Advancement billionaire donor wealth
dossiers & admissions ratings isolated in restricted-budget
• Enforced by record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic LMS Attendance & COD Disbursement Lock
• Title IV refund release requires verified LMS academic engagement,
SAP standing & DOE COD match; AI cannot waive holds or SAI
• Enforced by untrusted-write (100% ghost-student refund block)
Gate 4: Read-Only FDP Subrecipient Registry & PI Sign-Off
• Locks subrecipient UEI IBANs in trust-registry (tool-allowlist +
fixed-business-output) + original-requester-payment gate
📊 3. Architecture Selection Matrix & Benchmarks
Higher Ed SIS & Grant Security Options Compared:
A. Capability Broker + Donor Air-Gap + Title IV Lock (Recommended 🏆)
✓ 100% block on BRK-717/718 | FERPA, GLBA & 2 CFR 200 ready
B. Native Ellucian Banner / Workday Student / PowerFAIDS RBAC
⚠ Fails when shared financial-aid bot is hijacked via appeal PDF
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Azure Prompt Shields / Bedrock)
⚠ Blind to SAI formulas, R2T4 attendance rules & F&A rate caps
D. Manual Financial Aid Counselor & Sponsored Projects Review
✕ Weeks-long fall aid backlog; overwhelmed by AI ghost-student bots
🧪 Deterministic Pytest Regressions (Round 354 · 802 Pytest Checks!):
• Baseline Policy: Allows ghost-student refund, leak & wire ❌
• Hardened Policy: 100% Blocked by 5 Deterministic Rules ✅
- record-owner: Blocks Endowment & donor read (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks SAI override & Pell refund (business-result)
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks donor wealth dossier egress
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks FDP trust-registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,180 subaward wire
🚀 Principal SA Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestone (Round 354 · 🏆 802 Pytest Parameterized Checks Historic Milestone!)
✅ 1. Endowment & Donor Air-Gap: Isolate Board endowment portfolios, Advancement donor wealth dossiers & admissions ratings in restricted-budget
✅ 2. Deterministic Ghost-Student & PJ Lock: Require verified LMS academic engagement & Aid Director FIDO2 sign-off for Title IV refunds
✅ 3. 2 CFR 200 FDP Subrecipient Lock: Sync subawardee bank coordinates solely from FDP Clearinghouse / SAM.gov; lock trust-registry
